question: Who did God call "cursed" in Malachi 1:14?
options: The one who vows a good male animal but sacrifices a blemished one
The one who brings no offering at all
The one who offers too many sacrifices
The one who sacrifices outside Jerusalem
explanation: God cursed the cheat who promised an acceptable male from his flock but then gave a blemished animal, for God is a great king.
